anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius curve showing a low-profile, gradual convexity sloping anteriorly.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust horizontal extension with a high thickness-to-length ratio ending in a blunt terminal point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon descent and the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular pale depigmentation patches visible on the dorsal surface of the melon and at the anterior tip of the rostrum.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark ocular patch and a visible ventral-lateral skin fold or groove located posterior to the gape.
